summary: Iteration 2 frontend testing: AuraMax-style hero, MEET section, condensed 4-item navbar with Cửa hàng dropdown, new /about and /contact pages. All new features rendering correctly with proper data-testids. Regression on login → add-to-cart → cart drawer → checkout → SAVE10 coupon all working. 11/11 frontend tests passing.

issues: The 'Áp dụng' coupon-apply button text wraps onto 2 lines ('Áp\ndụng'). Minor: consider whitespace-nowrap or wider min-width on the button.

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): Add whitespace-nowrap (or px-5 + min-w) to coupon-apply-btn so 'Áp dụng' stays on a single line on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form is mocked (no POST to backend) — comment in Contact.jsx already calls this out; acceptable for current scope but should hit /api/v1/contact when backend endpoint is added.

Navbar.jsx: shopHover state on the whole navbar means only one dropdown can be open at a time — fine for current single-submenu design, but if more submenus are added, refactor to a per-item open state.

Both Home.jsx hero and About.jsx use the same Unsplash image (photo-1542744095-291d1f67b221) for HUMAN_LAPTOP/STORY_IMG — visually OK but consider differentiating to avoid déjà-vu between Home and About.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 frontend changes (navbar refactor + AuraMax-style hero + MEET section + new /about and /contact) all verified. Key data-testids used: nav-{Trang chủ|Cửa hàng|Về AuraTech|Liên hệ}, shop-submenu, submenu-{Tất cả sản phẩm|Gaming|Creator|Business}, hero-section, hero-wordmark, hero-laptop, hero-watch-btn, hero-tagline, hero-preorder-link, meet-section, meet-eyebrow, meet-shop-btn, meet-about-btn, about-page, contact-page, contact-form, contact-name, contact-email, contact-message, contact-submit-btn, mobile-nav-toggle, mobile-nav-drawer. Login uses login-username-input/login-password-input/login-submit-btn. Add to cart uses add-to-cart-detail-btn (not add-to-cart-btn). Coupon apply button is coupon-apply-btn.
